mirrorOrOtherProjectWarning: Pictures 19 and 23 show a different (modern-finish) variant, not the drawn house: rectangular timber-clad box bay instead of the half-octagonal stone bay, glass balustrades instead of wrought iron, square porch pillars without the arch, and a single long horizontal rear window instead of two windows; they were not used. Not mirrored (garage still at the front right). All other exterior pictures (1-4 elevations, 5 section, 8 site plan, 9/12/13/20/31/32 renders) agree with plans 27/30. 14-18, 21, 22, 24-26 are interiors (14-16 carry a ROMIQ interior-design logo) and give no geometry.

overall.basis: Front = facade labelled 'elewacja frontowa' (picture 3) = entrance and garage facade = bottom of the plan. Width 13.22 = printed overall '1322' = main rectangle wall to wall '1232' + enclosed half-octagonal dining bay projecting '90' on the left (the bay is enclosed living space, so it is included); main rectangle alone is 12.32. Depth 8.82 printed ('882'), front and rear walls straight. Garage (front right) is inside the main rectangle and included. Excluded: entrance porch, left terrace, driveway, balconies. Height 8.84 = ridge +8,37 minus front ground -0,47 (section 5), equal to the published 'Wysokosc budynku 8,84 m'. Published built-up area 111,76 m2 is a separate fact (polygon below 110.67).
